descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S20 「现成 api spec：AI 文字调用在放弃前会重试（两次 Haiku，然后 Mistral），查房前调用记下 AI 自己的时间和回答的模型」 Existing api specs: an AI text call retries (Haiku twice, then Mistral) before it gives up, and the pre-round call logs the AI's own time and the model that answered

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 Save Note timing: panels within 10-15 s, 15 s or less in at least 9/10 cycles (a target, not pass/fail; a run over 30 s not caused by the AI service is investigated). …（UAT 3.5；UAT 3.9）
  • T4 The summary-failed state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's style (never a blank screen, crash, raw error pop-up or invented content), loses nothing typed or dictated, appears only af …（TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 2；TFA-94745 AC 3；TFA-94745 AC 4；TFA-94745 AC 5；UAT Empty & Failure States；UAT 3.5）

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given Local backend, diagnostics cleared; chat() with bedrock.invoke stubbed: Haiku throttles twice and Mistral answers, and a run where all three attempts fail

When Call each AI action kind, parsing.parsePreRoundNotes included; ask once through the stubbed router

Then Calls go Haiku, Haiku, Mistral; the answer comes from Mistral with fellBackFrom Haiku; when all fail the error is thrown only after the third attempt; the parsePreRoundNotes row has providerMs (a number) and durationMs >= providerMs, and the log names the answering model

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright api assertions. This is the shared chat() router and its logging; it does not show parsePreRoundNotes' own retry loop, a hanging model (S27) or what the physician sees during the retries (Q10). Merged from the former S13 and S20

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 FAULT · 故障注入；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-10.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：FAULT · 故障注入；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
